unit.why: A brief anecdote: R. Zusha of Anipoli sees the image of his brother R. Elimelech in the leftovers a servant is carrying. It is cited from a book and closed with a verse interpretation, continuing the previous division's teaching on shirayim.
unit.boundary_note: anecdote is the illustrative tail of the shirayim teaching in the previous division

stories.start_quote: ובס׳ ה"ה מקץ פ״א ראה הקדוש
stories.summary_en: R. Zusha saw his brother R. Elimelech's image in his house and asked the servant what he was carrying; it turned out to be R. Elimelech's leftover food, which bore his holy brother's form, and the text reads this into the verse 'משאת מאת פניו'.

quotes: ראה הקדוש ר׳ זושא מאניפאלי בביתו צורת אחיו
tags.why: R. Zusha perceives his brother's form in the food, which others do not see
a supernatural sight seen while awake
the tzaddik's brother is involved; brothers are not on the definition's list
